arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'alive_progress/core/hook_manager.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('alive_progress.core.hook_manager')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import io
import sys
from threading import Condition
from alive_progress.core.hook_manager import buffered_hook_manager
from alive_progress.utils.terminal import get_term
orig_out = sys.stdout
cap = io.StringIO()
sys.stdout = cap
hm = buffered_hook_manager('', lambda: 0, 0, Condition(), get_term())
hm.install()
print('ok', end='')
hm.flush_buffers()
out_all = cap.getvalue()
hm.uninstall()
sys.stdout = orig_out
print('flushed', repr(out_all))
assert 'ok\n' in out_all, repr(out_all)
print('flush_newline_ok')

PYREPLAY
